caption:
What actually is a peptide? 🧬 Everything in your body is built from protein, and protein is built from amino acids linked like beads. A few links make a peptide. Hundreds make a protein. Insulin is a peptide hormone: 51 amino acids in two chains, shown here from its real 3D structure.

More at pepsafe.info

#peptides #biology #science #insulin #pepsafe

scenes.say: Everything in your body is built from protein.
And protein is built from amino acids, linked like beads.
A few links make a peptide.
Insulin is one. Fifty-one amino acids, folded into one exact shape.
